response.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS bats FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id) SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS num_managers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w) AS share FROM w GROUP BY bats

assumptions.assumption: Blank, whitespace-only, or NULL bats values are merged into a single group, shown as an empty string.

The total is the number of distinct award-winning managers matched to a player, so the shares sum to 1. This relies on player_id being unique in player. If it were not, a manager could be counted under more than one hand.
The share is a decimal fraction between 0 and 1, not a percentage. It is not rounded.
